messages: Maya Chen: quick one from usability — the 'Copy' affordance in the Query modal is getting overlooked. users try to select text instead of using the button. Devon Patel: saw that in Session 3 too. on 13" laptop the icon is tiny and sits too close to the line numbers. recommend increase tappable area and add visible label on hover. Anika Gomez: a11y: must be reachable via keyboard + announced properly. aria-label should include what is copied, e.g., 'Copy query'. avoid 'clipboard' as it confuses some screen reader users. Raj Singh: agree. also we need to avoid pushing modal content when we enlarge the button. maybe use absolute positioning inside header so layout doesn't shift. Maya Chen: microcopy poll: 'Copy query' vs 'Copy SQL' vs 'Copy' ? Research participants said 'Copy' felt too vague, 'Copy SQL' too technical for product managers. Devon Patel: vote for 'Copy query' — consistent with product language. Implementation idea: ``` ``` Add 44x44 hit area, tooltip on hover. Anika Gomez: add aria-live region for announcing success: "Query copied". make it polite so it doesn't interrupt screen reader flow. Also ensure color is not sole indicator — add check icon + text for visual confirmation. design-bot: audit warning: "Ensure focus style meets 3:1 contrast and does not rely on color alone." Raj Singh: CSS suggestion: use pseudo-element to expand hit target without changing layout: ``` .clipboard { position: relative; } .clipboard::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; } ``` Be careful with stacking context so the pseudo-element doesn't block clicks. Maya Chen: toast behavior question — should we use ephemeral toast top-right or inline 'Copied' chip next to the control? testers said toast felt disconnected. Devon Patel: inline chip near the button (fade after 1.5s) + aria-live announcement is ideal. Keep a fallback global toast for edge cases (e.g., when modal is scrolled out). Anika Gomez: keyboard flow: when copy occurs, focus should remain on the copy button. NVDA speaks aria-live content; screen reader users shouldn't be shifted. Also for screen magnifier users show a visible state change (check + label). Maya Chen: I'll mock three variants: A) icon-only with larger hit area + tooltip, B) icon+temporary inline chip, C) icon+label at narrow widths. Posting frames in ~45min. Raj Singh: can do a quick dev review after standup tomorrow to check z-index and focus ring CSS. Maya Chen: tagging @Devon and @Anika for implementation + a11y signoff. will leave thread open until PR + mocks are in. :thumbsup:
